column1: # Pilot round for Ch 3 §4–§6 (drafted 2026-10-31; pilot-before-sweep, docs/pilot_map.md).
# Every arm is the reference bank of r1k-stale-y50 (arms/rung1_cap.tsv: fire-sale bank,
# stale y 0.5, CARA 0.1, partial withdrawals, 1% deposit cap, sigma 2.5, r 0.05, d 0.6,
# common seeding, 25 initialisations) with ONE setting moved, on the same 15-cell
# Same seed offset and common seeding, so each arm pairs run for run with
# r1k-stale-y50, the control (already run; not repeated here). §3 needs no new arm:
# r1k-stale-y50 is the mu x lambda pilot on the current bank.
# What each pilot is for: where the sweep's levels on that axis should sit, not a
# hypothesis test (no pre-registration; the sweep's tests are stated in its design note).
# Read, per arm and cell, against r1k-stale-y50 (paired): P(fail), the I - C endogenous
# withdrawal gap, and loss_exact by type (who_runs_production.py, 2026-10-31).
#   - flat: |d P(fail)| < 0.02 in every cell and no change in the I - C gap -> the axis is a
#     stratifier in the sweep at the reference level only (or dropped);
#   - saturated: P(fail) > 0.95 or < 0.05 in most cells -> move the sweep's levels
#     inward (between the reference and this level);
#   - otherwise -> the sweep spans the reference and both pilot levels, packed where the
# For §6 the quantity of interest is the interaction: does the axis move the I - C gap
# or P(fail)'s slope in mu, not only P(fail)'s level.
# head-count announcement alpha 0.5, accurate and with spin b 0.05 [alpha 0];
# The stale level y (0.2 / 0.8) and sigma 1 are already run (r1k-stale-y20, -y80;
# r1c-stale-y50-s1 is uncapped sigma 1); not repeated.
